None of the BTC HEADWIND conditions (real yields UP and USD UP and liquidity flat/down) are met, since real yields and USD are not rising. None of the BTC TAILWIND conditions (liquidity UP strongly, USD DOWN, financial conditions easing) are met either, since liquidity is flat, not expanding. Read as MIXED/NEUTRAL: the supportive backdrop (healthy credit/funding, no USD/real-yield headwind) is offset by liquidity simply being flat rather than a genuine tailwind. Do not read crypto as a systemic-liquidity canary from this data alone.
